name: aurora
title: Aurora ribbons
description: Ribbons of light drift and are blended so that overlaps never blow out. It loops with no join at whole-number speeds.

props.name: ribbons
props.doc: Three ribbon colours, which also blend along each ribbon.

props.name: intensity
props.doc: How bright the ribbons are. 0.6 sits behind type; 1 is bold.

props.name: width
props.doc: How wide the ribbons are, as a multiple of the default.

props.name: speed
props.doc: How fast they flow. Whole numbers loop seamlessly over 10 seconds.

props.name: scale
props.doc: How long the waves are, as a multiple of the default. Higher is calmer.

props.name: grain
props.doc: Grain amount over the whole frame.
